meta.description: Separate multi-invoice extraction workflow. Detects invoice boundaries, extracts each invoice independently, and persists each result through the callback API.
meta.instructions: Import this file as a separate n8n workflow. Configure OPENAI_API_KEY, test with a PDF or DOC/DOCX containing at least two invoices, then activate it. The upload payload must include documentId, fileName, fileBase64, and callbackUrl.

parameters.jsCode:
const webhook = $node['Multi Invoice Webhook'].json.body || {};
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, rawText: webhook.rawOcrText || item.json.rawText || '' } }));

parameters.text: =Extract the invoice data from this document segment:\n\n{{ $json.rawOcrText }}

options.systemMessage: You are extracting exactly one invoice from a document segment. Return only valid JSON with these top-level fields: invoiceHeader (object), shipmentDetail (array), and chargeLineItems (array). Extract only values explicitly present in this invoice segment. Do not combine information from other invoices. Do not guess missing values. Use null for unavailable scalar values and empty arrays when no shipment or charge items are present.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ invoiceId: $json.invoiceId, invoiceIndex: $json.invoiceIndex, invoiceCount: $json.invoiceCount, pageStart: $json.pageStart, pageEnd: $json.pageEnd, rawOcrText: $json.rawOcrText, extractedData: $json.extractedData, confidenceScores: $json.confidenceScores, overallConfidence: $json.overallConfidence }) }}
